Read entire pseudocode, independent per-thread queues, oldest-first queue pruning, weighted popping, random maps, original epoch/map-selection inconsistencies and Gurobi tuning protocol.

Read complete tuning Table6, quadratic formulation and Table7, plus all dataset-generation details through PPI/Reddit. Distinguished identity-matrix quadratic expression and actual comparison results without generalizing formulation superiority.
Read all remaining real-world dataset definitions, exact source/preprocessing notes and Amazon MWIS counts; complete source all 25 pages including all appendix tables and references.

claims.statement: Hybrid solver performance needs attribution between learned guidance and conventional search components.
A unified MIS/MWIS suite reimplements guided search and exposes random/model/algorithm controls.
Tree-search training uses 20 stated epochs and tests original weights; the original epoch counts are nonstandard.
Means condition on found instances and times measure discovery of the eventual best solution; coverage and runtime-limit interpretation matter.
Fully equipped DGL SATLIB quality with random guidance matches or slightly exceeds trained guidance under the tested protocol.
Randomizing LwD lowers SATLIB average size from 423.48 to 144.85.
Missing original generation/hyperparameters prevents directly comparable verification of LwD large-graph scaling.
Experiments specify resource counts per configuration; full comparison tables use 8 threads sharing one GPU, with different classical/LwD threading.
This paper is a reproduction/benchmark analysis of MIS/MWIS solvers, not a shared trained generalist solver.
